scope: Authenticated volatile DRAM views for an explicitly opted-in owned virtual machine; host process is trusted

key_input.sequence: stage0, latch0, stage1, latch1; both required before configure
key_input.input_entropy_claim: None beyond actual supplied entropy; duplicated halves are accepted without claiming extra entropy

kdf.construction: SP800-108 counter mode HMAC-SHA256, r=32, one block
kdf.context: VMID16 || boot_random_salt32 || BE64(epoch) || BE32(region_id) || BE64(physical_base) || BE64(active_length)
kdf.output: AES256 GCM key, kept only in private expanded backend context
kdf.boot_salt_requirement: Fresh cryptographic random32 for every new core object; no fixed fallback; caller owns entropy generation
kdf.epoch_requirement: Nonzero immutable epoch supplied by owner; full reset creates a new object with new salt/epoch

aead.generation: Trusted device state; increments for every initial encryption and every updated touched line; no re-use within an object
aead.limit_behavior: Further active writes fault and wipe cache/expanded key; no wrap or auto-rekey
aead.counter_budget_initialization: Complete initialization must fit remaining generation budget before any publication
aead.security_bound: At most 2^32-1 invocations across object, 64-byte plaintext per invocation, full128-bit tags; this invocation limit is not a claim of negligible aggregate forgery risk under arbitrary hostile query budgets

memory_contract.private_cache: Borrowed SEP-only ROMD memory. Owner must eliminate all AP/unprotected aliases, intercept every store, limit direct read/fetch mappings to active prefix, and cover every DMA path
memory_contract.before_initialize: Private reads/writes may access isolated cache; external reads always deny; no crypto-ready claim
memory_contract.initialize: Encrypt all active64-byte lines before atomic publication; zero cache tail beyond active length
memory_contract.private_active_write: Authenticate every touched old line before RMW; stage all replacements before publication; copy plaintext only after successful authenticated ciphertext commit
memory_contract.private_active_read: Authenticate all touched lines before copying any output
memory_contract.external_read: Only authenticated ciphertext bytes; tags and expected-generation map remain in trusted device state
memory_contract.external_write: Always denied without mutation; no guest import/commit protocol is implemented
memory_contract.failure: Authentication failure, malformed active access, counter exhaustion or allocation failure permanently faults region and wipes its entire borrowed cache plus expanded GCM state before returning false
memory_contract.owner_failure_action: On false active bus access, fault/revoke mapping and flush ENTIRE borrowed capacity and translated code/TLB before SEP resumes; a zero-filled cache is not a page fault
memory_contract.owner_success_action: Flush ROMD/code translations for changed bytes before instruction execution
memory_contract.cache_lifetime: Reset/free core before freeing or reusing borrowed cache pointers

replay_reset.expected_generation: Separate trusted map must match record generation before decryption
replay_reset.reset: Permanently revoke old object; erase staged/latched inputs, expanded cipher state, records, tags, generations and full cache capacities
replay_reset.rom_control_200: Preserves MPE latches; not a full destructive reset
replay_reset.snapshot_migration: Live migration is unsupported and separately blocked by the owning integration. This core adds no generic QMP, debugger or complete dump guard. The SEP-only ROMD cache is outside the ordinary AP/system-memory view; host-admin/debug access including SEP CPU registers remains trusted and may reveal private data.
host_TCB: host inspection of SEP CPU registers
replay_reset.host_pointer_tamper: Outside guest threat model; no claim against host administrator or arbitrary emulator memory corruption

validation_boundary.synthetic_test_record_injection: Compiled only with HUNTMOB_VIRTUAL_MPE_TESTING, absent from normal engine builds
